title: Squatters out within 48 hours
detail: Fast court cases to remove squatters from homes (*okupació*) within 48 hours at most, with public help for vulnerable people. An organic law would let the police remove squatters at once if they are caught entering.
c: This matches PP, and LO 1/2025 already made cases faster. The 48 hours depends on how busy the courts are. Without the owner's consent, a home can be entered only with a court order or when someone is caught in the act (art. 18.2 of the Constitution). The fast police removal in this plan relies on that second case.
pos: It protects owners from people who live in a home without permission, so owners feel safer renting out homes.
neg: Vulnerable people could be evicted without proper checks. Courts are too busy, so 48 hours is hard to promise.

s.t: Ley Orgánica 1/2025 on the efficiency of the justice system (BOE)

title: Tax help: rent, mortgage, home savings account, 5% VAT
detail: Bring back a 15% income tax deduction for rent on a main home and 15% for mortgage payments on a main home, and bring back the home savings account (*cuenta vivienda*). Cut VAT on new main homes from 10% to 5% (with limits on size, price and income), and 5% on social housing. The state would pay the Generalitat for the tax money it loses.
c: The 15% deductions for mortgages and rent ended in 2013 and 2015. In our estimate, they helped push prices up. EU rules probably allow 5% VAT on new homes as social policy, but the state would lose a lot of tax money.
pos: Lower costs for tenants and buyers.
neg: In our estimate, the mortgage deduction (ended in 2013) helped push prices up. It is expensive for the state.

s.t: Ley 16/2012: end of the home-purchase deduction (BOE)
Ley 26/2014: end of the rent deduction in income tax from 2015 (BOE)
Directive (EU) 2022/542 on VAT rates (BOE copy of the OJEU)

title: Ban funds and banks from buying homes until 2028
detail: Until 2028, ban banks and their property companies, investment funds and asset managers from buying homes.
c: Banning banks and funds from buying homes goes against the EU rule on free movement of money and against the freedom to do business (art. 38 of the Constitution). Banks also have to take homes when people cannot pay their mortgage.

title: More rental homes through tax breaks, not rent limits
detail: Wider insurance against tenants who do not pay, tax breaks for landlords who rent at affordable prices, lower taxes on building and renovating affordable homes, and tax breaks for *SOCIMI* (property investment companies) only when they really build affordable homes to rent. The programme criticises rent limits (*topalls de preus*), and says they "do not create new flats".
c: The tax breaks are realistic. "No rent limits" is the opposite of PSOE, Sumar and ERC policy, and this would be the main point of conflict in any possible coalition.
pos: Tax breaks attract investors, so more homes are offered for rent.
neg: Without rent limits, tenants in cities with high demand lose protection.

title: A vote on independence, and independence
detail: Guarantee Catalonia's right to decide its future "by all necessary democratic means". Any referendum agreed with the state should ask the same question as on 1 October 2017. The programme calls the path to a "free Catalonia" a peaceful "democratic confrontation".
c: As with ERC, this is not possible without a change to the Constitution under art. 168. The programme does not say what "all necessary democratic means" would include.

title: Catalan language needed for *arraigo*; ban face veils
detail: People would need to know Catalan to get *arraigo* (residence based on your ties to Spain) and to renew permits. Clothes that fully or mostly cover the face would be banned in public places (niqab, burqa; the hijab is not included), based on a bill Junts presented in February 2026.
c: Language rules for *arraigo* belong to the state. Asking for Catalan instead of Spanish goes against having one immigration system for the whole country. A ban on face veils is possible by an organic law, as PP and Vox also propose.

title: A Catalan economic agreement outside the common system
detail: A law for a Catalan economic agreement (*concert econòmic*) outside the common regional funding law (*LOFCA*). The Catalan Tax Agency would collect and check all taxes paid in Catalonia, as in the Basque Country, and 100% of the Generalitat's *FLA* debt would be cancelled.
c: As with ERC, the Constitution allows a *concierto* outside LOFCA only for the historic territories. In our estimate, based on INE data, Catalonia produces about 19% of Spain's GDP. In our estimate, taking it out of the common system would leave much less money for the other regions.

title: Raise income tax bands with inflation; end inheritance tax
detail: Raise the income tax (*IRPF*) bands with inflation every year, cut the lowest rates and raise the personal and family tax-free amounts. End inheritance and gift tax (*Impuesto de Sucesiones*). Lower VAT on hairdressers (from 21% to 10%), and on care homes and care at home.
c: Linking income tax to inflation is the same idea as PP's. Inheritance tax is regional. Ending it at state level would need a new funding model, but Catalonia can bring it down to zero itself.
pos: The middle class pays less tax.
neg: The state gets less tax money, and ending inheritance tax helps rich people the most.
